description: Read-only local self-deployment attestation of the router-served process, immutable release, deterministic source and release surface digests, and already-loaded module origins. It never imports requested modules on demand.
embedding_description: Check the active local blue-green process for its immutable release identity and loaded Python module provenance. Use during reconciliation verification or to diagnose code that is present in a release but not imported.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Router-active process identity, release surface digests, and requested module origins.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with served_by_self and release identity. Surface unloaded modules and origins outside the immutable release root as verification evidence, not as successful proof.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read router-served local runtime code provenance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: The requested runtime identity could not be measured safely. This is an unreadable verification, not a code mismatch.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Inspect router and immutable release state, resolve the named read failure, then retry the read-only attestation.
